# Findra OHLCV Dataset (1-minute bars)

High-fidelity, deduplicated 1-minute OHLCV market bars across Cryptocurrency, Global Equities, and Real-Time Indexes.

**Notes**:
— Consider **1m/** as the source of truth. 
— The other timeframes, are pre-cached and pre-sampled from 1m/ candlestick data (ohlcv) for 15m, 1h, ... etc.
  — Giving faster re-sampling from 6 hours to 24 hours, for example.
    —From there Weekly, Montly, etc is even faster.
— Load .parquets into DB like DuckDB and just query on demand or calculate the timeframes you want.
— Remember, miniminum current definition is 1 minute (1m)

Anything, just send me a message or pull req. :)

## Structure
```
1m/
├── crypto/
│   ├── BTC.parquet  <--- BITCOIN ALL DATA MERGED in 1m candles
│   ├── ETH.parquet
│   └── ...
├── equities/
│   ├── AAPL.parquet    <--- APPLE ALL DATA MERGED in 1m candles
│   ├── NVDA.parquet  
│   └── ...
└── indexes/
    ├── ITOKENIZEDEQUITIESANDWRAPPEDASSETS.parquet  <--- indexes, ALL DATA MERGED in 1m candles (like QQQ etc, short levds, etc)
    └── ...
```

## Schema
- `ts`: UTC timestamp (DateTime64 or TIMESTAMP)
- `open`: Opening price
- `high`: High price
- `low`: Low price
- `close`: Closing price
- `volume`: Trade volume
